name: Leuphana University Luneburg
summary: Public university in Lüneburg, 30 minutes from Hamburg: a shared first semester, then a major plus a minor; seven English majors, no tuition.

ib.text: The IB must meet Germany's KMK rule. 30% of places go on grade alone, the rest on grade, extracurricular points and an optional English study-skills test. English: IB English A HL at 6, or e.g. IELTS 6.5.

apply.via: Leuphana's myCampus portal (EU/EEA citizens apply directly)

dates.label: Application deadline for winter semester 2027/28 (window opens mid-May)

programmes.name: Cultural Studies: Organization, Society, and the Arts
programmes.about: How the arts, cultural organisations and cultural theory shape society, combining cultural studies, sociology and arts management, with a semester abroad recommended in the second year.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. Ranked on grade plus up to 5 extracurricular points; in 2025/26 every valid applicant was admitted.

programmes.name: Digital Media
programmes.about: Media theory and history combined with hands-on projects in video, audio, games and apps and a practical start in programming; about half the teaching is at the Hamburg Media School, with an optional Hong Kong double degree.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. 30% of places on grade alone; the rest on up to 59 points: grade 30, extracurriculars 5, optional English study-skills test 24.

programmes.name: Economics
programmes.about: Economics with a strong empirical side: maths, statistics and software applied to growth, inflation, trade, environmental and behavioural questions, in small cohorts, with an optional semester abroad in year three.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. Ranked on grade plus up to 5 extracurricular points; in 2025/26 every valid applicant was admitted.

programmes.name: Global Environmental and Sustainability Sciences
programmes.about: Sustainability problems studied through ecology, sociology and economics at once, with models, statistics, lab and field work; you can add an integrated year at a partner university abroad, making it a four-year degree.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. Grade plus extracurricular points (and a study-skills test in years it is used); every valid applicant was admitted in 2025/26.

programmes.name: International Business Administration & Entrepreneurship
programmes.about: Business administration combined with entrepreneurship, sustainability and digital transformation in an AACSB-accredited programme; a double degree lets you spend years three and four at the University of Glasgow.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. 30% of places on grade alone; the rest on up to 59 points: grade 30, extracurriculars 5, optional English study-skills test 24.

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: Psychology applied to society (social, environmental, political and organisational behaviour) with training in statistics and research methods and a compulsory internship; it deliberately leaves out clinical psychology and psychotherapy.
programmes.ib: Does not qualify you for a psychotherapy or clinical psychology master. Pair it with the English Psychology & Society minor (itself restricted) for the DGPs-certified combination.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. 30% of places on grade alone; the rest on up to 59 points: grade 30, extracurriculars 5, optional English study-skills test 24.

programmes.name: Studium Individuale
programmes.about: A liberal-education degree where you design your own curriculum: seven English core modules, including a collaborative research project, plus electives chosen from courses across the whole university.
programmes.ib: Core modules are in English, but electives come from across Leuphana and some may require German. The only College major with a selection interview.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. 30% on grade alone; the rest on grade (30), extracurriculars (5) and an interview plus study-skills test (24, weighted 60/40).

notes: You combine your major with a minor; several minors are in English, and for a German-taught minor you should ideally have C1 German (DSH-2).
IB English B is not on Leuphana's English list: the IB route is English A HL at grade 6, otherwise a test such as IELTS 6.5, which may follow up to the start of lectures.
Around half of Digital Media's courses take place at the Hamburg Media School, the other half on the Lüneburg campus.
